text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our third-year summer camp comes to
an end.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You'll be late for the bus, you know.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I better get going!
I'll see you for more
top-notch training when we're
back at the
academy, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever boisterous and ready for more,
Winning
Ticket joins Biwa Hayahide and
Narita Taishin on
the bus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is the Arima Kinen. It's
time to get
pumped so we really can
make it the best race
ever!
choice_data_list: (I'm glad they were able to make up.)
